## 📝 Bug Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## 🔄 Steps to Reproduce
1. Enable mods
2. Launch the game
3. Open inventory
4. Spin the upgrader
5. Get an error

## ✅ Expected Behavior
Describe what was supposed to happen.

## ❌ Actual Behavior
Describe what happened instead (include error messages if any).

## 📜 Logs
Attach the log file: `release\cs2_gc\gc_log.txt`

## 🏷️ Version
Enter the version here (e.g., v. 0.2.1)

## 💡 Outside the Template
Write anything else that doesn't fit the sections above (leave blank if none).
